title: The raw signals each entry's score is computed from (packages/catalog/src/score.ts). Only the scheduled Update scores workflow writes this file.

asOf.description: The UTC day the signals were taken on; null until the workflow first runs.

entries.description: Each entry's signals by its key, the same as its like key.

signals.description: What was measured of one entry. A field that is left out was not measured, except released (never released) and archived (not archived).

repo.description: The repository measured; left out for a closed-source entry, which has only its likes.

path.description: The folder of the repository the entry lives in (an official package inside oneo-me/nsgo): its activity is the folder's, and its stars are not recorded.

weeks.description: Of the last 12 full weeks before asOf, how many the entry could have had commits in.

activeWeeks.description: How many of those weeks had commits; at most weeks.

license.description: The SPDX id GitHub detects, NOASSERTION for a license it cannot name, or null for a public repository without one.

osi.description: Whether the license is one the Open Source Initiative approves.

released.description: The day of the latest release or tag.

releaseDays.description: On how many days in the rolling 12-week window through asOf the repository published a release or had a tag.
